fusions.name: Beat the Brush
fusions.desc: Beats a cone of brush 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt that deals 17 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Widening Search
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to cast. For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Scent on the Wind
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your critical hit chance by 15% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
